# Apple Interview Guide

> The whole Apple loop: process, coding, system design, behavioral, levels, and a question bank. A free guide from DesignGurus.io, in plain Markdown, with no account required.

Each page is short and ends with links to full course lessons and free articles. Each description below is the opening sentence of that page.

## Guide pages

- [The Apple Behavioral Interview](https://github.com/design-gurus/apple-interview-guide/blob/main/behavioral-interview.md): Apple has no single behavioral round with a fixed rubric.
- [The Apple Coding Interview](https://github.com/design-gurus/apple-interview-guide/blob/main/coding-interview.md): Coding appears twice at Apple: once in the technical phone screen and again inside the onsite loop.
- [Common Mistakes in the Apple Interview](https://github.com/design-gurus/apple-interview-guide/blob/main/common-mistakes.md): A vague project answer is reported to hurt more at Apple than a missed algorithm question.
- [A Four-Week Plan for the Apple Interview](https://github.com/design-gurus/apple-interview-guide/blob/main/four-week-plan.md): Four weeks is enough time to prepare for an Apple loop if you study about ten hours each week.
- [The Apple Interview Process](https://github.com/design-gurus/apple-interview-guide/blob/main/interview-process.md): Apple is commonly reported to run four to six main stages for engineering roles: a resume screen, a recruiter call, a technical phone screen, an onsite loop, and a final manager round.
- [Apple Levels and the Interview](https://github.com/design-gurus/apple-interview-guide/blob/main/levels.md): Apple engineering levels run from ICT2 to ICT6, where ICT stands for individual contributor, technical.
- [Apple Interview Question Bank](https://github.com/design-gurus/apple-interview-guide/blob/main/question-bank.md): This page lists 58 practice questions for the Apple loop: 32 coding, 14 system design, and 12 behavioral.
- [How the Apple Loop Differs by Role](https://github.com/design-gurus/apple-interview-guide/blob/main/roles.md): Every Apple team builds its own loop, so the role changes the interview more at Apple than at most large companies.
- [The Apple System Design Interview](https://github.com/design-gurus/apple-interview-guide/blob/main/system-design-interview.md): Apple gives mid-level and senior candidates one design problem and 45 to 60 minutes to work through it.
